about.title: Welcome to Papa’s Choice
about.intro: Welcome to Papa’s Choice, your trusted African wholesale cash and carry in London. For the past 12 years, we have proudly dedicated ourselves to serving our community with authentic African and international foods, offering a wide range of quality products at competitive wholesale prices.
about.journeyTitle: From Humble Beginnings to a Growing Business
about.journeyText:
Every great journey starts somewhere, and for Papa's Choice, our journey began in a small unit beneath the railway arches in Deptford, southeast London.

What started as a small business was built on a vision, determination and a passion for bringing quality African food products to the community. Our beginnings were modest, but our ambitions were strong. With hard work, dedication, and the support of our customers, we began laying the foundations for what Papa's Choice would become.
about.communityText:
At Papa's Choice, we believe food is more than what we put on our plates. It connects us to our roots, brings families together and keeps our traditions alive.

From our humble beginnings in the railway arches of Deptford, we have been driven by a passion for bringing the flavours of home closer to our community. We understand the importance of finding the ingredients you know, the products you trust and the familiar tastes that make every meal special.

Whether you are shopping for your family, stocking your store or supplying your restaurant, we're proud to be part of your journey.

For us, it's not just about wholesale. It's about our roots, our relationships and the communities we serve.
